page.title: Configuration
page.purpose: Expose provider and local-runtime configuration with honest availability and precedence information.

priorities.statement: Separate global provider enablement from the user's processing destination, fallback consent and credit-spend policy.
Expose missing model, incompatible host and batch-only capability without implying that an enabled tier or stored key is qualified.
Show redacted credential metadata only; keep authorization and secret retrieval at the service boundary.
